text: jobsnearme 10-2 leg (landing/modal/signup): mockups published — modal https://claude.ai/artifact/83tYX8BqL867TKJdAeqV8h (A-D + phone M1/M2), signup https://claude.ai/artifact/2CMN8j6aYhrKS1w953LUNM (S1-S3, pick 2+3), landing https://claude.ai/artifact/Cc8Snmgru49QUrw94b7iLf; waiting on Alex's picks before specs/build
jobsnearme: client (Mark) agreed not to push live until the seeker signup is locked (10-2 meeting); the new landing replaces the choose-first two-button screen on / and /demo
jobsnearme later lift (not this leg): the signed-out root becomes the seeker home; /seeker/* must fold into it once signed in

jobsnearme 10-2 leg runs in worktree .claude/worktrees/oct2-leg on branch claude/oct2-leg: FS-294 landed (a8c1981d), FS-295 building, FS-297 ready and queued; landing wave FS-296/298/299 is critic-ready but waits on the owner's BQ answers and compliance sign; modal/signup specs wait on owner questions Q1-8
jobsnearme main checkout's node_modules is stale (missing pdfjs-dist and jszip), so typecheck fails there; the owner needs to run npm install since other sessions share it
jobsnearme spec files whose name ends in -tests.md are skipped by the RV-025 citation check (fs-citations.test.ts), so a spec named that way reads as a dangling id

jobsnearme specs keep test suites out of scope.files_expected (FS-015 / RV-025-B8 convention) except tests-only specs; max_loc counts gross non-test source insertions, so net-zero edits still spend it
jobsnearme save heart renders only under the corpus flag (offersSave), so e2e tests that need it must be named corpus-mode-*.spec.ts to run on the corpus-desktop/corpus-mobile projects (:3200)
jobsnearme landing hero art from Alexis has baked Starbucks and 'Amy W.' cards; proposed an 'Example' chip plus asking Alexis for layered art, pending the owner's answer (honesty rule)

jobsnearme 10-2 picks: desktop job modal build BOTH A (Alexis as drawn) and B (fit-first 3-col) fully working to compare before choosing; signup = connect-first code then profile builder with live employer preview; sign-in = email code + Google (no SMS, no Apple yet); landing + kind hover copy approved as mocked

jobsnearme employer visibility (owner 10-2): after the employer ACCEPTS a connect they see first name + last initial, experience and the intro — 'enough to make an informed decision without giving them everything'; contact info, pay ask, situation, stops, score stay hidden until the seeker shares

jobsnearme: in-sheet signup conflicts with FS-190's site lock (deployed site is signed in as the allowlisted demo account; a new account's session would re-lock the page) and FS-260 (/demo always presents signed out) — owner question Q14 asked 10-2
jobsnearme: VideoJobModal.tsx has FOUR no-larger-than-base pins; FS-232 TC-6 (base dedfb1c9) = 1148 lines = zero headroom on 10-2; zsh `$s:src` is a modifier — use ${s} when building git show paths

jobsnearme 10-2: walking distance = option B (ask how you get there first, then times sized to the mode; 'Walking distance' option goes away with a one-time mapping of saved answers to Walking + 15 min)

jobsnearme 10-2: landing employer card fields = Claude's proposal (commute narrows sample seekers by their shown commute estimate; pay range shown back in the employer view header and carried to onboarding; describe-your-business carried to onboarding only)

coter-kit 0.5.0 (pushed 0bd8dc6, installed on the Mac): /waiting lists what's waiting on the user (kind 'waiting' notes with link + ref like Q8), snapshot section + band count; resolve with a decision note's resolves. Sessions need a restart to load it

jobsnearme 10-2 build runs in two lanes: lane 1 worktree oct2-leg (FS-294 and FS-295 landed; FS-297 building, then FS-301), lane 2 worktree oct2-modal on claude/oct2-modal (FS-300 building, then 308, 302, 303, 304); merge lane 2 into claude/oct2-leg, never rebase

jobsnearme parallel e2e runs share fixed ports 3100/3200/4173, so implementers take a mkdir lock at /private/tmp/claude-501/jnm-e2e-lock before any playwright run and must never reuse a server they didn't start
jobsnearme signup specs FS-305/306/307 failed critic round 1; the findings to fold are in docs/51-feedback/10-2-mtg/signup-rework-notes.md, held until the owner answers Q11, Q12 and Q14
jobsnearme e2e: Playwright refuses one spec file importing another ("should not import test file"), so shared e2e helpers must be copied into the new spec or moved to a non-spec module
jobsnearme e2e route-focus TC-9(b) and route-with-stops FS-225 TC-3 already fail on the code before FS-295 (local-only Maps tests), so they are not regressions from this leg
jobsnearme spec front matter must not cite review ids like RV-025-B8 (check:docs fails), and notes outside specs must not cite unwritten FS ids (fs-citations check)
